subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**rang**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The sentence is written in the **simple past tense**, as it narrates events that occurred in the past (e.g., "It was Saturday evening last week", "I had stayed back").
 
• To maintain consistent past tense narration, the verb describing the action of the doorbell must also be in the past tense.
 
• The past tense of the verb **"ring"** is "**rang**", which fits the sentence structure: "someone rang the doorbell."
 
• Other options are incorrect: 
 
 
• "Ring" – base form, not suitable in past tense context.
 
• "Rings" – simple present tense.
 
• "Rung" – past participle, used with "has/had".
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Sentence: *At 5:00 p.m, someone rang__ the door bell.* 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Verb forms of "ring": 

 
 
• Base form: ring
 
• Past tense: rang
 
• Past participle: rung
 
 
 
• Use "rang" when narrating a simple completed action in the past.
